tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Search LiveSpot for upcoming events across Sweden. Use this when the user asks what's on, what events are happening, what to do, or anything about concerts, sport, theatre, or shows in a Swedish city. Supports free-text, city, category, date range, and max price. `query` matches event titles, so pass only the name you are looking for ("Bamse", "Djurgården") and express everything else as filters - a sentence like "concerts in Stockholm this weekend" matches no title. Returns a paginated markdown list of events where each title links to livespot.se. Preserve the markdown links when summarizing so users can click through. City slugs are ASCII (goteborg, malmo); Swedish characters are normalized automatically (å/ä→a, ö→o).

query.description: Event title to look for ("Metallica", "Bamse", "Djurgarden"). This matches the event name only, so put the city, dates and price in their own fields rather than in a sentence here.

city.description: City slug in ASCII (goteborg, malmo, stockholm). Swedish characters are replaced: å/ä→a, ö→o.

category.description: Category slug. Accepts Swedish or English: konsert/concert, teater/theatre, humor/comedy, etc.

startDate.description: Include only events on or after this date.

endDate.description: Include only events on or before this date.

maxPrice.description: Upper bound on price_min, in SEK.

limit.description: Results per page. Defaults to 10 to keep payloads under ~100KB.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Fetch the full detail for a single event. Accepts a full event id, a full slug, or the 8-character short id at the end of a slug (e.g. "f13a31ab"), as returned by search_events, browse_city, and search. Returns a markdown block with a linked title heading plus description, venue, city, date, and price. Preserve the title link when citing the event so users can click through.

id.description: Event id, slug, or short-id prefix as returned by search_events.

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: Return all LiveSpot cities with their slug, region, and upcoming-event count. Use the slug (ASCII) as the `city` argument to other tools.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Return the canonical LiveSpot category catalog with both Swedish and English slugs. Pass either slug to other tools as `category`.

tools.name: browse_city
tools.description: List upcoming events in a city, optionally narrowed by category. Equivalent to search_events with just {city, category}. Returns markdown bullets where each title links to livespot.se — preserve those links when summarizing. City slugs are ASCII (goteborg, malmo); Swedish characters are normalized automatically.

city.description: City slug in ASCII (e.g. goteborg, malmo).

tools.name: get_related_events
tools.description: Find events related to a given event (same city, nearby date, overlapping category). Returns markdown bullets where each title links to livespot.se — preserve those links when summarizing.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search LiveSpot events. Returns { results: [{ id, title, url }, ...] } per the OpenAI Deep Research spec. Event content originates from third-party ticket providers.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch a single LiveSpot event document. Returns { id, title, text, url, metadata } per the OpenAI Deep Research spec.

id.description: Resource id (event id or slug) returned by search.
